posts.title: From Babysitting AI to Developing the Factory
posts.description: Babysitting agents leaves little room for the troubleshooting that engineers enjoy. The harder challenge is developing a system that needs less babysitting.

posts.title: From Vibe Coding to Developing the Company
posts.description: Vibe coding can come full circle through a trusted engineering loop. Then the challenge expands: useful product outcomes, improving the factory, and helping the company work better.

posts.title: How to Scale Agentic Development by Changing the Work Before the Process
posts.description: Next Insurance broke its whole product development lifecycle into agent skills and deliberately kept sprints, roadmaps, Jira and the role split. Why authorship is the first thing to change in an agentic rollout, and how you know when the process change is finally due.
